Results.ReviewText: I live in a small apartment and will not be here for more than a few years max, so I didn't want to buy a big grill that I'd have to move soon, but I wanted something that would last.  The Q 1200 fits the bill, with the 5 gal. gas tank hose/adapter I've been grilling all summer long on my metal patio table, yet if I wanted, I can put it into my trunk and use a small camping tank on a picnic table.  So far it's run like a champ, very even temps (the built in thermometer is a nice touch) and taking out and cleaning the grills in my kitchen sink is way easier than anything I've grilled on before.  I'll probably get the folding stand for it at some point, but overall, it's everything I'd hoped for.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about your experience. We are happy to help. 

With regards to food sticking, we have the following recommendations:
 
1. You can oil the food directly, but we do not recommend applying any kind of oil directly to the grates. You can use our Weber Grill Spray, as that is not oil based.
2. Make sure you're giving your food enough time per side. Food will naturally start to rise off the grates when close to flipping time.
3. If using a marinade, try to get as much excess liquid off as possible before placing the food on the grill.
4. If using a sauce of any kind, wait until the last 5 minutes or so to apply.
5. We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill. Simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes with the lid closed and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush.

Our Support team is reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your business for so many years. Your Weber Q1200 grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest starting by double-checking your current gas pressure. The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

Here is a helpful link for review:
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023605032-How-hot-should-my-gas-grill-get-

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

Results.ReviewText:
The Q1200 grill has a known problem with the regulator. There are many complaints on Amazon reviews about this issue. It will not allow you to screw on a standard green 1 pound propane bottle because the bottle interferes with the rear wraparound handle. The 1 pound bottles are approved for use with this grill per the users manual, the website, and customer service, but they do not fit. So they sent me a replacement regulator which I installed. But since the regulator has not been redesigned, the 1 pound propane bottle still will not fit. 
Weber customer service has been terrible through this ordeal. They do not bother to read the emails, or look at the attached photos I send. They just repeatedly give you canned, off the wall, unrelated, canned answers. Totally useless. What good is their 5 year warranty?
If you ever intend to use this grill with the standard propane bottles, I would buy something else. If you intend to use it with a 20 pound tank and a hose, it should be OK.

Check out their "writing guidelines" when submitting a review:
"Avoid writing about customer service"
We wouldn't want to mention them would we? 

-Disappointed
Results.Title: Standard propane bottles do not fit the Q1200
